title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
hook_text: Websites are shutting out AI agents
script:
OpenAI and Meta built autonomous agents to scour the internet for you.
Those agents promise to handle dinner reservations and buy new shoes.
Websites are now closing their digital doors to stop those automated scrapers.
Google built similar tools to browse the web on your behalf.
Publishers and platforms are putting up blocks against uninvited bots.
Would you trust an autonomous agent to handle your online shopping?

editor.one_line: Strong premise, but visuals are repetitive and the script lacks specific, hard-hitting data.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace 'scour the internet' with 'scrape data' to be more precise.
LINE 3: Name a specific site or platform that has implemented these blocks.
LINE 5: Replace 'uninvited bots' with 'AI crawlers' for industry accuracy.
visual_notes: line 1: The robot graphic is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 2: Stock footage of a man with a credit card is generic and lacks brand identity.
line 5: The GPT-6 screenshot is irrelevant to the topic of website blocking.
